name: Naraha (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Naraha town emblem in green: a broken ring of two curved strokes enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Naraha, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1976.

features.role: Naraha town emblem — a broken ring of two curved strokes enclosing a ring
